title: Benchmark definition
description: tests/benchmarks/<id>.bench.yaml: what polypiler-tooling bench run measures, on which toolchain, how often and in which variants.

relativePath.description: A path relative to the repository root (sources, stdin, sizes.source) or to the run's directory (sizes.binary), without '..'.

id.description: The benchmark's ID; the file is named <id>.bench.yaml and its results artifacts/bench/<id>/.

kind.description: process: a program run by the cross-language runner, one sample per run; dotnet: a BenchmarkDotNet benchmark of Polypiler.Benchmarks, run once, one sample per iteration.

toolchain.description: The key of tooling/toolchains.lock whose executable the build and run steps start.

sources.description: Files copied into the run's directory under the same relative names.

build.description: The arguments of the build step; {root} and {configuration} are replaced.

run.description: The arguments of the run step; {root} and {configuration} are replaced.

stdin.description: A file the run reads on standard input.

expectStdout.description: The output every run must print, line ends normalized and final line ends ignored; a run that prints other is not a measurement (PLY0051).

variants.description: The variants, for example opt-none, opt-balanced and opt-speed; without it there is one variant named default.

binary.description: Read from the run's directory after the run and summed as binaryBytes; a directory counts every file below it.
